build.compiler_version:
Apple clang version 17.0.0 (clang-1700.4.4.1)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin

dataset.encoding: strict ASCII128, one byte per token

limitations: Fixed development screen, not a final-test or statistical-significance result.
LUT-normalized NLL is not ordinary softmax perplexity or the exact surrogate derivative.
Checkpoint validation arrays are directly recomputed; native route arrays are hash-bound only.
Training arrays are hash/coverage verified, not independently replayed step by step.
This audit shares the host observer with the screen; it is not an outside-group reproduction.
No hardware speed, power, GPU savings or useful LLM pretraining claim.
Binary inputs are local ignored artifacts; a fresh clone needs these or a new complete run.

recipe.baseline: alpha=1,128 symbols; target counts and within-window token-target pairs only

head_initialization.anchors: retain jitter at (5*v+seed)%512, subtract8192 elsewhere; zshift=4
head_initialization.wider: separate existing LCG seed XOR 0xA5A5A5A5; randint(-512,512); zshift=4

recipe.mechanism_evaluation: final validation, separately for every seed
recipe.scope: fixed CPU/CSIM mechanism screen; no adaptive extension, statistical significance, ordinary softmax perplexity, speed advantage or hardware execution claim
